integrity: Proof and a standalone finite verification program are included. No independent mathematical validation or external certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only uniform matroids U_{r,n} with integers 2<=r<n and rank-three first-order logic of pure inclusion. title: Five three-round theories of lattices of flats of uniform matroids
